Test Case Description: Verify invalid or tampered reset token is rejected
PreRequisites:
- User has received password reset email
- Reset token in URL has been modified or tampered with
Steps to Perform: Receive password reset email with valid token
Step Expected Result: Email contains reset link",System validates token signature and rejects tampered/invalid tokens. Error message is displayed."

Steps to Perform: Manually tamper with token in URL (change few characters)
Step Expected Result: URL is modified to contain invalid token

Steps to Perform: Open reset password page with tampered token

Step Expected Result:
- Error message: 'Link đặt lại mật khẩu không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn'
- Password reset form is not displayed or is disabled
- User is redirected to forgot password page
- Prompt to request new reset link
- No password reset is possible with invalid token
